description: Properties available for a specific Docker image on the device

mappings.doc: ID is the content-addressable ID of an image.
States whether the image with ID `image_id` has been pulled on the device.
Status of the image with ID `image_id` on the device. Possible values: [Missing, Pulling, Pulled, Deleting, Error]
List of content-addressable digests of locally available image manifests that the image is referenced from. Multiple manifests can refer to the same image.
